conclusion: The roughly nine-hour difference signal is displaced from the target in both inspected sectors. The positive-core sky positions agree to about 3.8 arcseconds. This supports contamination by a nearby variable source and motivates source-specific extraction diagnostics.
limitations: Approximate positive-core centroids, not precision PRF astrometry. Nominal pixel errors omit correlations. Source identity, physical type, novelty and any target planet remain unestablished.
